text:
ravi: Quick status check — I'm prepping Sirocco-2.7B (open) for catalog entry. Need clarity on three things: (1) license clearance, (2) perf profile for 2k seq/latency targets, (3) model-adapter CR to support kv-cache. Anyone owning these?

emma: I can own perf. Running a perf sweep today, will post numbers by EOD. baseline: 8.3 ms/token at batch=1 on A100-80GB for 512 seq (prelim). I'll include memory/kv-cache footprint.

karen: Legal — this model's license looks like an MIT-variant per initial scan but we need a confirm on third-party tokenizers. @legal-liaison can you confirm by tomorrow?

legal-liaison: Confirming. We need to audit `tokenizers/fast.py` vendor blobs and the README attribution. Pinged OSS legal, ETA ~24h.

sanjay: Runtime: adapter CR in review @ravi — small change to `kvcache.flush()` semantics, will finish review today. Also need infra to provision a canary route in us-east-1 (dedicated) for latency tail measurements.

ravi: Thanks. @infra-team can we get a small dedicated canary (1x4g) for ~48h to capture tail latency? Also pinging @karen for catalog metadata: model card, intended tasks, recommended quant profiles.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: `sirocco-2.7b-canary` -> us-east-1 at 2025-06-15T03:00Z. Status: queued.

emma: Quick note: perf sweep shows a regen cost regression with 2k seq when kv disabled. Need kv enabled for production-representative numbers.

karen: Noted. If OSS legal signs off on tokenizer blobs we're clear on licensing. I'll update the curation checklist and owner matrix.

ravi: Owners confirmed: perf=emma, legal=legal-liaison, runtime=sanjay, infra=infra-team, catalog=karen/ravi. I'll open a PR linking perf artifacts, canary config, and the draft model card. :thumbsup:
